newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT says earnings include one-time gain.
newsitem.headline: PLDT says earnings include one-time gain.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co (PLDT) said on Thursday its net profit in the first half of 1997 rose 28.6 percent to 3.75 billion pesos from 2.92 billion a year ago.
It said the figure included an extraordinary gain of 118.5 million pesos.

Operating revenues in the first six months improved 15.2 percent to 15.91 billion pesos from 13.82 billion pesos. Revenues from national long distance calls posted the strongest growth while international call revenues remained flat.
Without the one time gain, net income growth in the first six months would have been only 24.6 percent higher, the country's largest telephone company said.
Fully-diluted earnings per share (EPS) was 27.50 pesos against 20.99 in the year-ago period.
Without the one-time gain, the EPS was at 26.52 pesos.

The extraordinary income came from a 703 million-peso gain from the increase in the net assets of affiliate Pilipino Telephone Corp and a non-recurring expense of 585 million pesos from its employee redundancy programme.
